commitResults.messageTitle: Update duplicate name check for add contact command
Make phone, email, and address optional fields
commitResults.messageBody:
Phone, email, and address fields are now optional to support customers
who use different contact methods (e.g. phone only, email only).

Changes made:
* Person model now accepts null for phone/email/address
* Getters return Optional<Phone>, Optional<Email>, Optional<Address>
* AddCommandParser validates at least one contact method is provided
* PersonCard conditionally displays optional fields
* JsonAdaptedPerson handles null values with @JsonInclude(NON_NULL)

Note: Tests will be fixed in subsequent commits as
this is a breaking change. Two other optional fields,
Instagram and Telegram handles, will be added soonafter.

commitResults.messageTitle: Update test utilities for optional fields
commitResults.messageBody:
PersonBuilder, EditPersonDescriptorBuilder, and PersonUtil are
updated to work with optional phone/email/address fields.

Changes made:
* PersonBuilder constructor uses orElse(null) to extract Optional values
* EditPersonDescriptorBuilder handles Optional fields correctly
* PersonUtil.getPersonDetails() uses ifPresent() for optional fields
